name: Canvas
description: Screens you put together yourself: buttons, switches, sliders, readouts, labels and a clock on a grid, each tied to a value or an action of any device. A canvas is a small JSON document, so a person or an agent can make one.

abilities.title: See canvases
abilities.description: Open the canvases and see every value on the connections this screen has been given.

abilities.title: Use everything on a canvas
abilities.description: Press the buttons and move the sliders of any canvas.
abilities.caution: A canvas shows only what someone put on it, but this reaches everything on the connections this screen has been given.

abilities.title: See my own ear mix on a canvas
abilities.description: Open the canvases, and see the names of the inputs and the sends into the person's own bus. Nothing else on them.

abilities.title: Adjust my own ear mix on a canvas
abilities.description: Change the sends into the person's own bus. Nobody else's, whatever a canvas has on it.

abilities.title: Arrange canvases
abilities.description: Start a canvas, arrange what is on one, and remove one.
abilities.caution: Whoever makes a canvas decides what the people using it have in front of them.
